description: Post-AW-III close. Six waves closed every AW-II correctness residual and landed the architectural transposition: walker specialisation per grammar (W4, dispatch_one removed from the hot path), stage-1 SIMD structural pre-pass with the new bbnf-simd-scan crate (W5.b, 4775 MB/s standalone on twitter; W5.d wires it into parse()), driver dual-cursor + push_compound_fused + savepoint slot (W5.c), fused SoA write API replacing reserve_compound everywhere, and W6.A substrate for the five emitter-mined consumers plus W6.4 universal named-type binding table and W6.5 Pratt PRECEDENCE_LUT. The bench-gate target of strict-better-than post-AU on 15/19 entries is NOT MET: zero entries exceed post-AU; the transposition landed as substrate and the final mile of consumer-activation wiring (ShapeRef compound-emit, KEYWORD_PHF emission, ClassifyByte emission, CTNS lift, bounded Regex, direct-to-struct resolver connection, Pratt LUT consumer wiring, DFA codegen specialisation) is the declared W1 opener of AW-IV. W4's samply confirms dispatch_one at 0% on the hot path; W5's samply confirms bbnf_simd_scan::neon::scan at 12.13% — the architectural properties the plan invoked are real and verifiable. The 5-40x regression vs post-AU observed at AW-II open is therefore a consequence of paying SIMD-scan and walker-interpreter overhead without yet amortising on the consumer side.
bench_matrix_note: Cold per-parse only (mimalloc). The README tranche-completion matrix enumerates 17 parse entries (json 5 + css 3 + sheets 3 + bbnf 6); the plan's '19-entry' wording additionally counts the sheets format_simple + format_stress entries that are measured by the same bench but are pretty-print format benches rather than parse benches. Both are reported below for continuity with post-AU.json + post-AW.json; the 15-of-19 gate applies to the parse entries against post-AU.
baseline_reference: post-AU (docs/benchmarks/post-AU.json). post-AU was the fn-per-rule hot-path high-water mark before the DTA activation. Every AW-III entry measures the DTA-primary parse path after the architectural transposition.
gate_attribution: 0 of 17 parse entries strictly better than post-AU. Two format entries (sheets format_*) are within noise. The transposition landed as substrate: walker is specialised per grammar (dispatch_one 0% self-time on json twitter), stage-1 SIMD is wired (bbnf_simd_scan::neon::scan at 12.13%), dual-cursor populated, Pratt LUT emitted, universal named-type binding table landed, CTNS / ClassifyByte / pattern-alphabet substrate landed. Consumer activation for ShapeRef (SHAPE_DICT empty across grammars), PHF (0 tables emitted — threshold not met across current grammar Alts), ClassifyByte (0 tables emitted — compute_dispatch subsumes candidates), CTNS lift (gated off — tape-side Span-emitting record path pending), bounded Regex (per-pattern alphabets dense — defeats bound), Pratt consumer (walker's ShuntingYard arm still uses linear scan over PRECEDENCE_ENTRIES rather than the packed LUT) is declared as the opener of AW-IV.

regression_rationales.universal_gate_miss: Every parse entry regresses versus post-AU. The regression has one shape across all 17 parse entries: the walker runs specialised per grammar and stage-1 SIMD runs at 12.13% self-time, but the two levers that close the gap to post-AU — (1) the regex-scanner's runtime DFA interpreter replaced by per-pattern straight-line codegen, and (2) the emitter-mined consumers (PHF, ClassifyByte, ShapeRef, direct-to-struct, Pratt LUT consumer, bounded Regex, CTNS lift) — are substrate-only after AW-III.W6. The architectural transposition the plan invoked is complete and verifiable; the consumer-activation completion that translates the transposition into live throughput was scoped into AW-IV per the successor chain.
regression_rationales.sheets_small_input_documented_tradeoff: parse_simple (505 B), parse_nested (1.5 KB), parse_stress (1.8 KB) are documented in AW-III.md as small-input amortisation facts — stage-1 SIMD + walker specialisation fixed-cost amortisation does not break even at these cardinalities. The plan declared these three entries as out-of-gate small-input tradeoff. They remain so.
regression_rationales.css_dense_alphabet_pathology: CSS L4 mines [0..127] as its structural alphabet (every byte is structural). The SIMD index produces ~one entry per input byte; the walker's ByteDispatch slot-advance is paid per byte with no amortisation. The Regex bound speedup that W5.c briefly claimed reverted in W5.d because it collapsed to zero-width scans on dense alphabets. Per-pattern alphabet narrowing (W6.A substrate) is required to re-enable the bound; pattern-alphabet mining landed but pattern alphabets in CSS L4 + Sheets are themselves dense, so the disjointness witness does not hold today. AW-IV widens the narrowing pass.
regression_rationales.format_entries_within_noise: format_simple and format_stress do not consult the walker; their regression is pprint runtime drift versus post-AU. Outside AW-III scope.

honesty_note: The tranche-level hard gate (strict-better-than post-AU on 15/19 entries) is NOT MET. The architectural transposition the plan declared as the prerequisite to that gate IS complete and verifiable: walker specialised per grammar (dispatch_one 0% self-time), stage-1 SIMD active (12.13% self-time), dual-cursor populated, fused SoA writes replacing reserve_compound, bbnf-simd-scan crate shipped with NEON + AVX2 + AVX-512 + WASM + scalar kernels + CLMUL/PMULL quote-parity + 37 correctness/parity/digraph/fuzz tests. The W6 consumer activations landed as substrate: SHAPE_DICT emits (empty for current grammars), PRECEDENCE_LUT emits (walker ShuntingYard arm still uses linear scan), universal named-type binding table lands (emit_view_impl consumer wiring not yet connected), KEYWORD_PHF and ClassifyByte infrastructure lands (zero emissions at current thresholds), pattern-alphabet mining lands (bounded Regex defeated by dense alphabets), CTNS lift lands (gated off pending tape-side Span-emitting record path). The AW-IV successor opens with a single-agent 'consumer-activation-completion' wave whose scope is wiring these substrates into the walker's hot path; DFA codegen specialisation follows. The 5-40x regression vs post-AU does not invalidate the transposition; it reflects paying SIMD-scan and interpreter-cycle overhead without yet amortising on the consumer side. FINAL-III.md records this truthfully.
